messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: elevated 5xx error rate detected for service=redwood-gateway-usw2 (pattern: 502/504 spikes across frontdoor) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: symptoms: 5xx rate ~18% over last 5m, p95 latency up 3x, retries amplified. Paging on-call: @maria.s (primary) -> please ACK and triage
maria.s: acked. I'm on it. seeing a big spike in 502s from envoy at the edge. digging into route stats now.
devon: me too, looking at LB metrics — cluster load looks normal but one route shard is returning 502s. which upstream?
maria.s: envoy histograms point to upstream pool "inference-backend-v2" in us-west-2-e region. a bunch of 502s + 503s. suspect retry loop -> cb tripped.
samir: adding context — we rolled route-weight change 18m ago to shift traffic to v2 for performance testing. maybe routing skew + retries caused overload.
ira: can someone paste the envoy config for that route? I want to check retry policy and circuit_breakers settings.
maria.s: pulling config now.
marianote: (system) running `kubectl -n gateway get configmap envoy-config -o yaml`
maria.s: ```
route:
  name: /v1/generate
  weighted_clusters:
    - name: inference-backend-v2
      weight: 80
    - name: inference-backend-v1
      weight: 20
  retry_policy:
    retry_on: 5xx,connect,refused_stream
    num_retries: 3
circuit_breakers:
  max_connections: 1000
  max_retries: 5
```
devon: OK that's aggressive. num_retries=3 + weight 80 -> backend-v2 getting retried requests amplified. if v2 has a transient perf regression, this cascades.
samir: logs from pods show increased 502s and 504s with `upstream request timeout` and `connection reset by peer`. also many requests with `x-envoy-retry-count` > 0.
cs-ana: we are seeing a small but rising set of customer error reports — some request failures and timeouts. triage says SRE impact could be S2 if not mitigated.
ira: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) disable client retries at edge (set num_retries: 0) 2) shift route weight away from v2 to v1 (reduce to 10) 3) bump circuit breaker thresholds temporarily or unwind CB so requests fail fast. Which is safest?
maria.s: plan: apply temporary config patch to reduce retries and route weight, then scale backend v2 if needed. I'll do config change via gitops rollback to the pre-change commit.
devon: i'll prepare a hotpatch if gitops is slow. we should also add a direct failover to v1 by weight.
ops-bot: deploy-bot queued: argo rollouts detected new config commit https://git.redwood/infra/envoy-config/commit/ab12f.. will start rollout if approved.
maria.s: doing a quick test patch locally to confirm syntax.
(30s pause)
maria.s: Applying emergency patch:
```bash
kubectl -n gateway patch cm envoy-config --patch '{"route":{"retry_policy":{"num_retries":0},"weighted_clusters":[{"name":"inference-backend-v2","weight":10},{"name":"inference-backend-v1","weight":90}]}}' --type=merge
```
devon: doing a smoke curl after the patch: `curl -sS -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null https://gateway-usw2.redwood/v1/generate` -> 200s consistently for 10 calls.
samir: metrics in Datadog: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 3% within 45s of patch. p95 latency trending down. good.
ira: nice. follow-up: keep retries disabled for now, open a post-incident to investigate why v2 degraded. we may have a resource or kernel issue on that shard.
cs-ana: notify CS: I'll send a short customer message acknowledging impact and that we mitigated; mention degraded errors between timestamp window.
maria.s: handing to devon for next 2h on-call — I need to jump to another pager. devon, please take over and document mitigation steps and what to monitor.
devon: taking over. will keep monitoring for 30m then escalate to infra if it resurges. docing checklist: rollback route weight -> disable retries -> scale v2 pods -> check kernel OOM/conn resets -> check network egress.
ops-bot: argo-rollout: emergency rollback to commit 6c3f applied to envoy-config (author: maria.s). Status: successful.
ira: add action item: add a guardrail in CI to prevent route weight > 70 on experimental variants, and require canary for 10m with throttled weight increases.
maria.s: +1. also add automated alert for retry amplification pattern: high retries + rising 5xx within 5m.
samir: opened PR to add more verbose upstream healthchecks for inference-backend-v2 pods and to surface `x-envoy-upstream-health` metrics. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4821
devon: logging handoff summary for incident channel: root cause suspected: route weight shift to v2 combined with aggressive retry policy caused retry amplification and upstream overload leading to 502/504s and circuit breaker tripping. mitigation: immediate rollback of route weight to v1, disabled retries, circuit breaker unwound temporarily. customer impact: increased 5xx between 16:23-16:26 UTC, estimated affected requests ~1.2% of global traffic (~800k requests). next steps: postmortem, CI guardrails, canary behavior change.
cs-ana: I posted incident note to customers with ETA for postmortem.
ira: leaving a tag for followups: #postmortem, #retry-guards, #envoy-configs. handing back to you @devon.
devon: thanks all — keeping this thread open for 2h, will update if anything changes. closing initial mitigation. :white_check_mark:
